title: Preceptor Aldous states the Regent's writ needs only one hollow burned ('A hollow burned clean — one is proof enough for the Regent') the first time I asked, but after my second burn the same NPC in the same location says 'Two hollows burned clean... The Regent will want Cinderhall's name on this' and only then issues the writ — his own two statements contradict each other.
where: Cinderhall — Ironbound Chapterhouse / talk to Preceptor Aldous, 'the Regent's writ'
